terms.adjustments: Refunded or fraudulent stores may be reversed; geography determines bounty.

caveats: The $150 model assumes qualifying US/listed-region merchants; use $25 or a weighted amount for other traffic.
The purchase funnel must mean full-price conversion, not initial trial signup.
Main affiliate page mentions 400-day post-trial tracking while Growth Center says 125 days; confirm the Impact contract rather than promising either maximum.
modelAssumptions: Average monthly customer spend is an editable scenario assumption, not a quoted vendor plan or observed Seller Insider Hub referral.

programs.name: Etsy
programs.summary: Etsy pays commission on attributed shopper purchases, excluding shipping, taxes, refunds and cancellations. Public policy says rates vary by affiliate and channel; no fixed rate is assumed.

terms.payoutSummary: Current help identifies Rakuten and payment after order validation; marketplace return windows affect timing.
terms.eligibility: Approved channels and last-referrer attribution; website 30 days, creator/app 7 days.
terms.adjustments: This does not pay recurring SaaS commission or a bounty for merely opening an Etsy seller shop.

caveats: A marketplace purchase model and actual accepted rate are needed; this is excluded from SaaS subscription forecasts.

programs.name: HeyGen
programs.summary: From November 1, the current base creator tier pays 20% for six months. Higher 25% and 30% tiers depend on conversions. The program explicitly excludes SEO/blog-only promotion.

terms.payoutSummary: $100 minimum; 60-day verification; monthly PayPal payouts in the first three days.
terms.eligibility: Original video on social/course platforms; generally 5,000+ followers. Site-only publisher traffic does not meet the advertised channel rules.
terms.adjustments: The former 35% / three-month offer and expired 50% promotion are not current base terms.

caveats: Retained in the opportunity inventory, excluded from website-only revenue scenarios.
A separately approved video channel could be modeled using 20% / 6 months after eligibility confirmation.

Confirm eligible current plan names; legacy recurring referrals do not establish terms for new ones.
Two payout months and the $5 platform floor are explicit planning assumptions pending account-specific settlement terms.
modelAssumptions: This is a one-time $25 bounty; no renewals are earned for new referrals.
An annual $100,000 cap applies after modeled reversals; actual provider accounting governs.
Payout delay and floor are editable planning assumptions, not a guaranteed bank date.

terms.adjustments: Choose 11% when modeling Business-plan referrals.

The $5 floor is a planning placeholder, not a verified product-specific threshold.

benchmarks.summary: Reported $197.3 million of quarterly revenue and $4.3 million of GAAP net income. Its SMB revenue declined 11% year over year, primarily because of continued organic-search pressure.
benchmarks.caveat: A mature financial marketplace and guidance business with several financial-product categories, operations, and distribution channels. These are company results, not a software-affiliate conversion benchmark or a Seller Insider Hub earnings target.

benchmarks.summary: Its official investor highlights report £349.1 million of half-year revenue and £83.3 million of adjusted EBITDA, a 24% adjusted EBITDA margin. Revenue declined 8% year over year.
benchmarks.caveat: A diversified specialist-media group with advertising, subscriptions, ecommerce, and comparison businesses. Adjusted EBITDA is not net income; netIncome is intentionally null in this record. Different currencies and reporting periods must remain labeled. These figures do not establish a margin or growth forecast for a new publication.

evidenceNotes.topic: HubSpot commission duration and withdrawal minimum
evidenceNotes.finding: 30% recurring for up to one year; 180-day cookie; $10 withdrawal minimum. Public policies defer the lock duration and exact applicable offer to the affiliate tool.
30-day hold, $100 open balance, at least two different referrals, Friday settlement. These gates materially delay early cash compared with earned commissions.

The worked example includes the 31-day hold before the following review cycle. The separate FAQ compresses that explanation. The model uses an explicit approximation, rather than promising a precise payout date.
The selected model is SEO Toolkit's base $200 sale payment. Higher-tier maxima, other toolkit prices, and paid trial actions are separate.

Official search retrieval exposed the HY2026 highlights, while one open-page extraction showed the older FY2025 highlights. The separate official results page identifies HY2026 and its 24% adjusted margin. No FY2026 full-year forecast is presented as a realized result.
